CFML Language Reference: Functions

Month

Returns the month number of a date/time value; January is 1.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

Month(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A number from 1 to 12.

Usage

Same as DatePart("m", date). Pass the result to MonthAsString for the month's name.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Date</TH><TH>Month</TH><TH>Name</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="D" LIST="1/15/2000,Jul 4 1999,10/22/1999">
<TR><TD>#D#</TD><TD>#Month(D)#</TD><TD>#MonthAsString(Month(D))#</TD></TR>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

MonthAsString, Year, Day, Quarter, DatePart
